items.title: With Julian Reese and Cam Whitmore both waived, did Washington get Tre Mann and a 2nd round pick for free?

items.body_excerpt: I initially assumed the Cavs had some interest in Whitmore to make the Wizards inclusion make sense, but if they do not then why were the Wizards even included? Is Tre Mann considered a negative asset?
